status: synthetic/controlled pilot architecture only; not authentic production-pilot evidence
purpose: Bind plural-authority, assurance, conflict, explanation, challenge, reassessment, rollback, and evidence-retention semantics into reversible low-consequence workflows before any consequential use.
prohibited_workflow_classes: discipline custody liberty or eligibility decision
real clinical diagnosis or treatment decision
credential issuance with real-world legal effect
production access grant to sensitive system
pilot_entry_gates: synthetic or separately governed low-risk data
explicit scope and named participants where human participants exist
challenge window and retained evidence defined
no capability-registry or public-supported claim promotion
independent review remains a separate gate for any later consequential promotion
promotion_rule: Passing this profile demonstrates only that the experimental workflow behaved as expected under the tested low-consequence conditions. It does not promote the workflow, mechanism, domain, or infrastructure to production or consequential use.
nonclaims: Synthetic conformance is not authentic pilot evidence.
A successful reversible pilot does not establish safety for irreversible or high-consequence use.
This profile does not waive existing production-readiness, independent-security-review, legal/governance, accessibility, or domain-specific gates.
Pilot success does not create authority.
